vote.question: FUTARCHY CONDITIONAL RESOLUTION [US-AK U.S. Senate]: Dan Sullivan (R) has accumulated $24,726,126 in career FEC-reported receipts (anchored this cycle by MAGA Inc. ($200,000,000) and $560,907,000 from top-5 patrons)—exhibiting the "Extractive Energy & Petrochemical Capture" profile. Will independent constituent & oracle review confirm that this private-interest capital concentration compromises public representation in US-AK, thereby executing the AK Corrective Restitution Pool toward clean water remediation, community grid resilience, and environmental health clinics?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Private campaign financing treats US-AK representation as an investable asset class. When Dan Sullivan's campaign apparatus absorbs $24,726,126 (anchored this cycle by MAGA Inc. ($200,000,000) and $560,907,000 from top-5 patrons), policy incentives skew toward regulatory leniency toward industrial emissions, grid monopolies, and watershed externalities. This futarchy market converts spectator outrage into direct fiscal counter-leverage.
options: Yes — Confirm Capture & Execute State Restitution Bounty
No — Veto Capture Claim & Roll Escrow Pool to Bipartisan Commons
Abstain — Log On-Chain Constituent Dissent Only

outcomes.YES_EXECUTE_RESTITUTION: Confirms special-interest capture; releases 100% of escrowed pool to audited state 501(c)(3) restitution beneficiaries — direct corrective remediation of the captured constituent impact.

If the No option wins, funds redirect to a bipartisan district-wide common good that strengthens the entire community — denying special interests the ability to commandeer the bounty and promoting positive-sum governance over zero-sum subjugation.
